claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_caster_turn_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The damage accumulation fires 'whenever your turn ends and the spell hasn't ended'. OngoingTrigger has on_caster_turn_start but no on_caster_turn_end. These are mechanically distinct: start-of-turn fires before the caster acts, end-of-turn fires after all actions/bonus-actions/movement resolve.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the damage increases by 1d6 whenever your turn ends and the spell hasn't ended

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.accumulated
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The explosion damage starts at 12d6 and grows +1d6 per caster turn-end during concentration. This is a stateful counter that accumulates at runtime — not derivable from any static axis (character/class/slot/subclass/PB). Requires a new DiceAmount variant, e.g. { kind: 'accumulated', base: DiceExpr, perTrigger: DiceExprDelta, trigger: OngoingTrigger } where the runtime engine tracks how many times the trigger fired and multiplies perTrigger by that count. The upcast variant (base increases by 1d6 per slot above 7) is a standard slot-scaling on top of this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell's base damage is 12d6, and the damage increases by 1d6 whenever your turn ends and the spell hasn't ended.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_spell_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The sphere-area explosion fires 'when the spell ends' regardless of cause — natural expiry, dropped concentration, bead-touch failure, or thrown-bead collision. There is no OngoingTrigger variant that fires when the host effect itself terminates. The closest existing triggers (on_caster_turn_start, on_attached_turn_start) fire on a recurring schedule, not on termination.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When the spell ends, the bead explodes, and each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_creature_touches_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The bead-touch mechanic fires a save gate when any creature physically contacts the attached bead object mid-duration. OngoingTrigger has on_creature_enters_area and on_creature_moves but no touch-contact event for an object attachment.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If a creature touches the glowing bead before the spell ends, that creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SaveSuccessOutcome: throw_object_up_to_feet
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On a successful bead-touch save the creature may throw the bead up to 40 feet, with collision semantics that end the spell (triggering the explosion). This is a player-chosen repositioning action on the spell's object attachment with a distance cap and termination-on-collision rule. No SaveSuccessOutcome variant or EffectAtom covers granting the target an ad-hoc throw action on an active spell object.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a successful save, the creature can throw the bead up to 40 feet. If the thrown bead enters a creature's space or collides with a solid object, the spell ends, and the bead explodes.
